message.content:
Build the admin LOGS section and a DB-backed editable EMAIL system for Nxeon at /opt/nxeon. Other agents edit OTHER areas concurrently — touch ONLY YOUR OWNED FILES.

## PRIMER
- Next.js 15 + Prisma. `"use server"` = async-only exports. `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`; admin gate `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` → `await requireArea("platform")`. Design: `.card`,`.table-shell`,`.btn-*`,`.input`; `import { PageHeader, Badge, timeAgo } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`.
- NEW models: `EmailTemplate { key(unique), name, category, subject, html, enabled }`; `EmailLog { toEmail, subject, template, html, status, error, userId, createdAt }`. Existing: `AuditLog { userId, user, action, detail, createdAt }`, `Job`, `WalletTransaction`. Invoices: `import` from `lib/invoices.ts` (READ it — has invoice HTML/PDF generation; find the function that returns a PDF Buffer for an Invoice).
- READ FIRST: `lib/mailer.ts` (you EDIT it — preserve its exported API: `sendMail(...)` and the `emails` object callers use), `app/admin/audit/page.tsx` (audit table pattern), `app/admin/email-templates/page.tsx` + `components/admin/EmailTemplatePreview.tsx` (existing preview pattern to build on).

## TASK
1. **Editable email templates (deep dive).** `prisma/seed-email-templates.ts` — seed a COMPREHENSIVE set of branded, editable templates with `{{variable}}` placeholders and a `category`, idempotent upsert by `key`, then RUN it (`npx tsx prisma/seed-email-templates.ts`). Keys to include: welcome, email_verify, password_reset, password_changed, server_provisioned, server_suspended, server_terminated, server_expiring, receipt, invoice_new, renewal_reminder, payment_failed, dunning_warning, ticket_reply, twofa_enabled, api_token_created, referral_reward, domain_registered, domain_expiring, coupon_applied. Give each a real, useful branded HTML body (shared header/footer, dark-friendly, {{vars}}).
2. **`lib/email-render.ts`** — `renderTemplate(key, vars)` loads the `EmailTemplate` (fallback to a minimal default if missing/disabled), substitutes `{{vars}}`, returns `{ subject, html }`; and a `recordEmail(toEmail, subject, template, html, status, error?, userId?)` writing an `EmailLog`.
3. **Rework `lib/mailer.ts`** — keep the public API working for all existing callers. Route sends through `renderTemplate` when a template key is used, LOG every send to `EmailLog` (SENT on success, FAILED + error on throw), and for the `receipt`/`invoice_new`/`renewal_reminder` emails ATTACH the invoice PDF (nodemailer `attachments`, using `lib/invoices.ts`). Do NOT break existing `emails.*` callers — map them onto the new template keys.
4. **Admin email-template editor** `components/admin/EmailTemplateEditor.tsx` (`"use client"`) — list templates by category, edit subject + html, toggle enabled, live preview iframe, a `{{variable}}` cheatsheet. Wire to `lib/actions-email-templates.ts` (`"use server"`: `saveEmailTemplate`, `toggleEmailTemplate`, `resetEmailTemplate` — all `requireArea("platform")`). (This editor will be mounted in Settings by another agent.)
5. **Email log viewer** `components/admin/EmailLogViewer.tsx` — table of sent emails (to/subject/template/status/time) with a per-row **preview** (iframe of the stored `html`).
6. **Logs hub** `app/admin/logs/page.tsx` (`requireArea("platform")`) — tabs via `?tab=audit|activity|email`: **audit** = `AuditLog` table; **activity** = an aggregated recent-activity feed (merge recent logins/orders/payments/jobs from AuditLog + Job + WalletTransaction into one time-sorted list); **email** = render `<EmailLogViewer/>`.

## OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
CREATE: `prisma/seed-email-templates.ts`, `lib/email-render.ts`, `lib/actions-email-templates.ts`, `components/admin/EmailTemplateEditor.tsx`, `components/admin/EmailLogViewer.tsx`, `app/admin/logs/page.tsx`. EDIT (sole owner): `lib/mailer.ts`.

## HARD RULES
NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config, layouts, lib/db.ts, lib/rbac.ts, lib/invoices.ts, app/admin/settings/**, app/admin/email-templates/**, worker/*, ROADMAP, docs/**, sitemap, or files not in your list. Do NOT run build/prisma-push/generate/restart (you MAY run the seed tsx). No commits, no new deps. `"use server"` = async-only; never re-export from a "use server" file.

## REPORT
Files created/edited; the full list of seeded template keys (+ confirm seed ran); how mailer now renders/logs/attaches PDFs; INTEGRATION NEEDED (nav link `/admin/logs`; that Settings should mount `EmailTemplateEditor`); risks.

New `sendTemplate(key, to, vars, opts)` convenience wraps this.
- **Log**: every send writes an `EmailLog` row — `SENT` on success, `FAILED` + error on throw (and `FAILED`/"SMTP not configured" when unconfigured), storing the rendered HTML for preview.
- **PDF attach**: for `receipt` / `invoice_new` / `renewal_reminder`, when an `invoiceId` is passed, `sendMail` attaches the invoice. **Note:** there is no PDF library installed and I can't add deps or touch `lib/invoices.ts` — that lib only exposes `renderInvoiceHTML` (the site's own invoice route serves HTML for Print→Save-as-PDF). ## Risks / notes
- Invoice attachment is HTML, not a true PDF (no PDF dependency available) — flagged above.
- The editor's live preview uses a small client-side replica of `wrapEmail` for instant rendering; the branded shell markup is duplicated there and in `lib/email-render.ts`, so keep them in sync if the shell changes. Actual sends always use the authoritative server wrap.
- `emails.*` objects now include an extra `template` field; harmless (spread into the existing preview page, no excess-property errors).
- In environments with SMTP unconfigured, every attempted send records a `FAILED`/"SMTP not configured" EmailLog row (visible in the Email tab) — intentional so nothing vanishes silently.
